name: YJ Pocket Cube 3x3
description: The YJ Pocket Cube is a compact 50mm magnetic 3x3 that’s perfect for cubing on the go. While it’s not a flagship model, it delivers surprisingly smooth turning and reliable performance in a smaller form factor. Whether you’re looking for a travel-friendly option or just want something fun and functional to keep in your pocket, this cube is a great choice for casual solves and quick sessions.
